entities.name: Nikahin_App_Core
observations: Nikahin is an all-in-one Flutter standalone mobile application for wedding planning (Android & iOS).
Spun off and evolved from the Wedding Planner module of TrackIt (Kotlin/Compose) into an independent cross-platform Flutter app.
Repository: rivaldiekaptrrr/nikahin_app, workspace located at c:/Rivaldi/nikahin_app.
Follows an Online-First Cloud-Synced architectural pattern with Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore sync, Midtrans payment gateway, and Drift SQLite as local offline cache.
Strict prohibition on hardcoding app version strings (e.g. 'Versi X.X.X') in UI; version must always be resolved dynamically via PackageInfo.fromPlatform().

Anti-Slop Visual Rule: Strict prohibition on wrapping subheaders, taglines, intro texts, or quotes in generic 'Pill Badges' / capsule containers. Typography must breathe freely with clean editorial hierarchy without gratuitous AI-slop capsule wrappers.

Release & Git Workflow Rule: DILARANG KERAS melakukan blanket release commit tunggal (seperti menyatukan seluruh fitur/aset/bugfix/docs ke dalam 'chore(release): bump version...'). Setiap perubahan WAJIB di-commit secara bertahap dan atomik sesuai modul/konteks (feat, style, refactor, docs) sebagai commit lokal biasa tanpa rilis. Hanya pada tahap terakhir, commit versi (chore(release): bump version to vX.X.X and update release notes pada pubspec.yaml dan RELEASE_NOTES.md) dieksekusi bersama push ke master dan pembuatan/push git tag rilis.
UI language and user-facing strings are strictly in Indonesian with Bento Grid and Material 3 design system.
Brand design guidelines and logo craft powered by logo-design skill (.agents/skills/logo-design/SKILL.md) and DESIGN.md.

entities.name: Nikahin_Tech_Stack
observations: Framework: Flutter (SDK ^3.8.0) & Dart 3.
State Management: Flutter Riverpod.
Database: Drift (SQLite) + sqlite3_flutter_libs for smart local caching and offline persistence when network drops.
Routing & Navigation: GoRouter.
Documents & Export: pdf, printing, and share_plus for A4 Wedding Guidebook PDF and CSV guest list exports.
Security: local_auth for Biometric (Fingerprint/Face) and PIN lock protection.
Key-Value Storage: shared_preferences for user settings, theme modes (Light/Dark/System), and reminders.
In-App Updater powered by package_info_plus, open_filex, and GitHub Releases REST API.
CI/CD Dual-Platform workflow on GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/multiplatform-build.yml) supporting automated APK releases from git tags (v*) and internal main builds.

entities.name: Nikahin_Features_Catalog
observations: Dashboard & Countdown: Interactive D-day countdown timer, custom romantic quotes with typography styling, quick summary cards for budget, tasks, and documents.
Budget & Payment Terms: Itemized expense tracking (Venue, Catering, MUA, Dokumentasi, Seserahan, dll.) with milestone payment terms (Belum Bayar, DP Terbayar, Lunas).
Vendor Management: Vendor directory with PIC contact, contract value, and payment progress.
Guests & RSVP: Guestbook with classification (Keluarga CPP/CPW, Teman CPP/CPW, VIP, Umum), session targeting (Akad, Resepsi, Keduanya), pax counter, and CSV export for reception desk.
Rundown Timeline: Multi-event chronological timeline (Lamaran, Pengajian, Siraman, Akad Nikah, Resepsi) with visual timeline nodes and assigned PIC per session.
Documents Checklist: Legal KUA & Catatan Sipil administrative document checklist for CPP & CPW with deadline auto-sorting.
Seserahan & Committee: Hantaran/gift items status tracking (Belum Beli, Dibeli, Sedang Dihias, Siap) and committee roles with family fabric/uniform allocations.
PDF Guidebook Export: Full A4 printable wedding guidebook report generator with auto-pagination and clean table layout.
In-App Updater: Automatic silent background check on startup and manual check button in Settings with download progress bar and direct APK installation trigger.
Release Notes Generator: Automatic extraction of RELEASE_NOTES.md content to GitHub Releases.

entities.name: Nikahin_Architecture_Structure
observations: lib/app: App entry point, MaterialApp configuration, theme mode provider, and GoRouter definitions.
lib/data: Local Drift SQLite database tables, DAOs, Firestore REST remote sync handlers, and repository layer.
lib/domain: Domain models, entities, and business logic enums.
lib/features: Feature-first module structure (auth, budget, committee, dashboard, documents, guests, profile_select, rundown, seserahan, settings, tasks, vendors).
lib/shared: Common utility helpers (currency/date formatters, PDF/CSV generators) and reusable UI widgets (Bento Card, Guide Dialogs, Pickers).
lib/ui/theme: Color palettes (Light/Dark/System), typography, and Bento Grid UI tokens.

entities.name: Nikahin_CI_CD_Release_Workflow
observations: Project Nikahin uses an automated Dual-Platform CI/CD workflow on GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/multiplatform-build.yml).
GOLDEN RULE: Always run local validation (flutter analyze, flutter test, flutter build apk --release) BEFORE pushing to GitHub or tagging releases.
Push to master/main triggers internal artifact build (app-nikahin-main.apk) without creating public release.
Pushing version tag (v*, e.g., v1.0.0) automatically generates a GitHub Release with APK asset and uses RELEASE_NOTES.md as changelog.
Platform toggles are managed centrally via lib/app/config/platform_config.dart and the platform-flags job in multiplatform-build.yml.
Skill file stored locally in .agents/skills/flutter-cicd-release-workflow/SKILL.md.

entities.name: Nikahin_Environment_Setup
observations: Standard environment: Flutter SDK 3.47.6+ (Dart ^3.13.5) on stable channel at C:/src/flutter.
Java JDK: Eclipse Adoptium / Temurin JDK 17 (JAVA_HOME).
Android SDK: C:/Android/sdk with Android SDK Platforms 36/35, Build-Tools 36.0.0/35.0.0, Android NDK r28c (28.2.x), CMake 3.22.1.
Environment variables: JAVA_HOME, ANDROID_HOME, ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, and PATH containing flutter/bin, platform-tools, cmdline-tools/latest/bin.
Project initialization: flutter pub get, followed by mandatory Drift SQLite generation: dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs.
Validation pipeline: flutter analyze (0 errors), flutter test (51 tests passed), flutter build apk --release.
Skill file stored locally in .agents/skills/flutter-environment-setup/SKILL.md.

entities.name: Nikahin_Knowledge_Sync
observations: Local-First Single Source of Truth: .agents/knowledge_graph.json is the master knowledge reference stored in Git.
Write Flow: Every new entity, observation, or architectural discovery must first be saved into .agents/knowledge_graph.json, then synced to active MCP Memory via create_entities / add_observations.
Read Flow: On new machines or when MCP Memory lacks Nikahin entities, read .agents/knowledge_graph.json and hydrate MCP Memory using create_entities and create_relations.
Skill documentation stored locally in .agents/skills/local-knowledge-sync/SKILL.md.

entities.name: Nikahin_Brand_Identity
observations: Official brand visual identity combines the Sacred Wedding Gold Ring, 3-Bar Financial Growth Chart, and Heart Peak Knot on Warm Champagne plate (#FFFBF5 -> #F8E7D8).
Design guidelines documented in docs/BRAND_GUIDELINES.md following Warm Editorial Wedding aesthetics.
Color system: Deep Wine / Plum (#4A1328), Warm Champagne Cream (#FFFBF5 -> #FDF2E9), Multi-Tone Wedding Gold (#DFB743 -> #AA771C), Romantic Magenta/Rose (#DE1A66 -> #B80D57).

Master scalable vector assets stored in assets/logo/svg/: symbol (master/black/white), horizontal lockup (1200x400 light/dark), stacked vertical lockup (600x680 light/dark), app-icon plates (full/fg/bg).
Onboarding Welcome Screen custom vector illustrations in assets/illustrations/ (welcome_slide_1.svg, welcome_slide_2.svg, welcome_slide_3.svg) rendered to assets/images/ (PNG 512x512).

Multi-platform app icon suites integrated across Android (android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-*/), iOS (ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/), Windows (windows/runner/resources/app_icon.ico), macOS (macos/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/), and Web (web/favicon.png, web/icons/, assets/logo/app_icon/web/).
Code integration points: lib/features/auth/welcome_screen.dart, lib/features/auth/login_screen.dart, lib/features/settings/presentation/widgets/settings_app_info_card.dart, and pubspec.yaml.
End-to-end launch workflow standard and file change checklist documented in .agents/skills/flutter-brand-logo-launch/SKILL.md with turnkey generator script generate_flutter_brand_assets.py.

entities.name: Nikahin_Payment_Gateway_System
observations: Sistem pembayaran & monetisasi lisensi VIP Nikahin dikelola secara sentral di lib/app/config/business_config.dart.
Sakelar Toggle Pembayaran: BusinessConfig.useManualPaymentMode.

Mode Manual (useManualPaymentMode = true): Mengaktifkan QRIS statis (assets/images/qris.jpeg) dengan fitur download/zoom/salin nominal, tombol konfirmasi WhatsApp otomatis ke Admin (+6287834284141), dan verifikasi aktivasi manual melalui Admin Panel/Supabase.

Mode Otomatis Midtrans (useManualPaymentMode = false): Mengaktifkan Midtrans Core API direct payment dengan modal seleksi channel (PaymentChannelSelectionModal: GoPay, ShopeePay, QRIS Dinamis, Virtual Accounts), diproses melalui endpoint Vercel serverless (midtransCoreChargeBackendUrl) dan layar instruksi dinamis MidtransCustomPaymentScreen.

Implementasi UI berada pada lib/features/auth/presentation/pending_verification_screen.dart yang secara reaktif memilih antara _buildManualPaymentContent() dan _buildDirectPaymentContent() berdasarkan nilai toggle.
Layanan remote pembayaran dikelola oleh lib/data/remote/midtrans_payment_service.dart dan diintegrasikan ke auth state notifier di lib/features/auth/presentation/auth_notifier.dart.
Detail Lisensi: Paket Wedding Planner Seumur Hidup (Lifetime Pass) seharga Rp 49.000 (diskon 50% dari harga normal Rp 99.000).

observations: Repository Sumber: https://github.com/firebase/agent-skills.git
Lokasi Lokal: .agents/skills/ (firebase-firestore, firebase-auth-basics, firestore-rules-creation, firebase-security-rules-auditor, firebase-basics, dll.)
Mandatory Rule: Setiap tugas yang menyangkut Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, REST API fields, updateMask, dan Security Rules WAJIB merujuk dan menerapkan panduan resmi dari skill ini.
